sources.snippet: Greater Accuracy with Fewer Parameters: With advancements in model design, YOLO11m achieves a higher mean Average Precision (mAP) on the COCO dataset while using 22% fewer parameters than YOLOv8m, making it computationally efficient without compromising accuracy.
